sentences.en: He has a suspected blood clot and needs medical attention.
sentences.zh: 他疑似有血块需要医疗关注。

sentences.en: He has a suspected blood clot and needs urgent medical attention.
sentences.zh: 他疑似有血块需要立即医疗处理。

sentences.en: They're globular structures that tend to knit together, forming large clots.
sentences.zh: 它们是倾向于聚集在一起形成大血块的球状结构。

senses.zh: 凝块，黏团（尤指血块）；（非正式）笨蛋，傻瓜
